protocol.study: Longer GPU learning-budget study on the fixed assumed Bahrain model
protocol.primary_endpoint: Final deterministic fine-grid policy from every training seed; no best-checkpoint selection
protocol.secondary_endpoint: Final stochastic coarse/fine paired evaluations with five fixed action-noise seeds; summarize within training seed first
protocol.aggregation: Mean, sample standard deviation and range across three training seeds; no significance or convergence claim from this sample alone
protocol.conditions: Same55 decisions/lap, model, initial/terminal70 m/s, battery/reserve and reward as accepted pilot; no empirical final-test inputs
protocol.rng_isolation: Every evaluation restores Python, NumPy, torch CPU and all CUDA RNG states; each coarse/fine stochastic member starts from the same evaluation seed
protocol.schedule: Constant learning rate and clip range; training state persists across4096-step learn calls; separate evaluation environments
protocol.gate: All reported final policies feasible; absolute gain-versus-zero discrepancy <=0.05 s between training and fine grids for deterministic and each stochastic pair
protocol.failure_policy: Preserve failed seeds and partial checkpoints; do not exclude a seed to improve the average. All three must complete for an accepted study.
